state:
**Goal `goal-closeout`, Stage 4 (finished in place).** The gap `callback-that-reshapes-the-subject-reshapes` is closed. Every `Core\Arr` member that calls back into Novis code takes its array arguments through `Held` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/arr.rs`, which retains each for the walk, so a callback's write to the subject copies first. The module doc's § *A member that calls back holds what it walks* is the rule and its cost. The Rust test `a_callback_that_writes_to_the_subject_walks_what_it_started_with` is the one `php-oracle-retired`'s `nvs-stdlib-the-m11-decisions-hold` check names, and the hostile case `tests/hostile/core/Arr/filter/01-predicates-written-to-break-the-walk.nvs` step 4 now runs to its end.

That same check still names two tests that do not exist: `pow_mod_returns_the_least_non_negative_residue` and `a_search_never_matches_inside_a_grapheme`. Both designs are settled in `docs/agent/goals/php-oracle-retired.md` § the three bullets at line 234.

The only `nvs-runtime` gap left is `enum-case-that-reached-a-mixed`. It needs an ADR beyond Stage 5's one slot, so it waits for the user. It goes to `BLOCKED` only once it is the last goal-owned gap in the tree.

The floor check `the latest CI run on main succeeded for the code HEAD holds` is red only because `main` is ahead of `origin/main`, and the loop never pushes. A person has to push.

A change to a `Core` implementation file stales the perf figure of every feature it implements. Re-measure each with `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group <class>`.

`bun nv owners --closes goal-closeout` names the rest, in `nvs-lsp`, `nvs-stdlib`, `nvs-syntax`, `nvs-types`, `editors/vscode` and `website`.
